name: VCPComfyUIPlugin
description: Allows AI to generate images using a local ComfyUI instance via VCP. Supports LoRA management, auto-registration, and intelligent matching.
author: Your Name / AI Assistant

configSchema.name: COMFYUI_BASE_URL
configSchema.description: Base URL of the ComfyUI server (e.g., http://127.0.0.1:8001).

configSchema.name: COMFYUI_WORKFLOWS_PATH
configSchema.description: Relative path to the directory containing ComfyUI API workflow JSON files (e.g., ./workflows).

configSchema.name: COMFYUI_OUTPUT_IMAGE_TYPE
configSchema.description: Type of image data to return: 'url' (direct URL from ComfyUI) or 'base64' (base64 encoded image data).

configSchema.name: COMFYUI_REQUEST_TIMEOUT_SECONDS
configSchema.description: Timeout in seconds for individual requests to ComfyUI server (e.g., polling history).

configSchema.name: COMFYUI_LORA_PATH
configSchema.description: Local LoRA directory path for scanning .safetensors files and reading embedded metadata. If not set, will only use ComfyUI API to list LoRAs.

invocationCommands.description: Generates an image using ComfyUI. Provide either 'workflow_id' to use a pre-existing workflow file or 'workflow_json' to use a dynamically generated one. Optional parameters: prompt, negative_prompt, model_name, seed, steps, cfg, loras (array of {lora_name, strength}), auto_match_lora (boolean).
invocationCommands.example:
<<<[TOOL_REQUEST]>>>
tool_name:「始」VCPComfyUIPlugin「末」,
workflow_id:「始」basic_txt2img.json「末」,
prompt:「始」a beautiful landscape painting「末」,
loras:「始」[{"lora_name": "detail_tweaker.safetensors", "strength": 0.8}]「末」,
seed:「始」12345「末」
<<<[END_TOOL_REQUEST]>>>

invocationCommands.description: Lists all available ComfyUI workflow files found in the plugin's configured workflows directory.
Discovers all available resources from the ComfyUI instance, including checkpoints, LoRAs, samplers, schedulers, VAEs, and available nodes.
Generates a ComfyUI workflow JSON from an AI-provided abstract description. Parameters: ai_workflow_description (string, required).

Lists all registered LoRAs with their metadata. Parameters: refresh (boolean, scan ComfyUI for new LoRAs), auto_register (boolean, automatically infer metadata for new LoRAs), use_civitai (boolean, fetch metadata from Civitai API).
Gets detailed information about a specific LoRA including description, tags, trigger words, and usage statistics.
Manually registers or updates a LoRA with metadata. Parameters: lora_name (required), description, tags (array), trigger_words (array), strength_range, default_strength, compatible_styles (array).
invocationCommands.example:
<<<[TOOL_REQUEST]>>>
tool_name:「始」VCPComfyUIPlugin「末」,
command:「始」register_lora「末」,
lora_name:「始」anime_style.safetensors「末」,
description:「始」Anime style LoRA for generating anime-like images「末」,
tags:「始」["anime", "style", "illustration"]「末」,
trigger_words:「始」["anime style", "anime art"]「末」,
default_strength:「始」0.8「末」
<<<[END_TOOL_REQUEST]>>>

invocationCommands.description: Automatically registers ALL LoRAs from ComfyUI with inferred metadata. Parameters: use_civitai (boolean, fetch from Civitai API, default true), force_update (boolean, update existing entries, default false). This command scans all LoRAs and infers metadata from filename patterns and Civitai.
Intelligently matches LoRAs based on context, prompt, and style hints. Returns ranked list of matching LoRAs with recommended strengths.
invocationCommands.example:
<<<[TOOL_REQUEST]>>>
tool_name:「始」VCPComfyUIPlugin「末」,
command:「始」match_loras「末」,
prompt:「始」a beautiful anime girl with long hair「末」,
context:「始」user wants anime style illustration「末」,
max_results:「始」3「末」
<<<[END_TOOL_REQUEST]>>>

invocationCommands.description: Scans local LoRA directory for .safetensors files and reads embedded metadata. This command directly reads LoRA files from disk, extracting training parameters, tags, and trigger words from the safetensors header. Parameters: lora_dir (optional, uses COMFYUI_LORA_PATH config if not specified).
